fullName.value: Breast cancer type 2 susceptibility protein homolog
Fanconi anemia group D1 protein homolog

texts.value: Tumor suppressor protein that maintains genome stability primarily by repairing damaged DNA through homologous recombination (HR) (PubMed:9126738). Facilitates the repair of double-strand breaks (DSBs) by binding and mediating the loading of the RAD51 protein onto single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), thereby promoting the activity of RAD51, which catalyzes DNA strand exchange (By similarity). BRCA2 nucleates and stabilizes RAD51 on ssDNA directly and delivers RAD51 to ssDNA-double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) junctions by sliding along dsDNA backbone (By similarity). RAD51 targeting to ssDNA promotes removal of replication protein-A (RPA) from ssDNA and stabilization of RAD51-ssDNA filaments by blocking ATP hydrolysis (By similarity). May play a role in the extension step after strand invasion at replication-dependent DNA double-strand breaks; together with PALB2 is involved in both POLH localization at collapsed replication forks and DNA polymerization activity (By similarity). Required to prevent R-loop-associated DNA damage and thus transcription-associated genomic instability (By similarity). Silencing of BRCA2 promotes R-loop accumulation at actively transcribed genes in replicating and non-replicating cells, suggesting that BRCA2 mediates the control of R-loop associated genomic instability, independently of its known role in homologous recombination (By similarity). Also promotes RAD51 loading to telomeric regions, facilitating telomere replication and capping (By similarity). Also required for homologous recombination during meiosis by promoting the recruitment of RAD51 and DMC1 recombinases to meiotic DSB sites, enabling proper chromosome pairing and crossing over (By similarity). Also promotes homologous recombination by inactivating the FIGNL1-FIRRM complex to protect RAD51 filament from premature disassembly (By similarity). Together with NPM1, may also regulate centrosome duplication (By similarity)

Monomer and dimer (By similarity). Interacts with RAD51; regulates RAD51 recruitment and function at sites of DNA repair (PubMed:30760716, PubMed:9126738). Interacts with DMC1; regulates DMC1 recruitment and function at sites of meiotic double-strand breaks (DSBs) (By similarity). Interacts with WDR16, USP11, ROCK2 and NPM1 (By similarity). Interacts with SEM1; the interaction masks a nuclear export signal in BRCA2 (PubMed:12228710). Interacts with both non-ubiquitinated and monoubiquitinated FANCD2; this complex also includes XRCC3 and phosphorylated FANCG (By similarity). Part of a BRCA complex containing BRCA1, BRCA2 and PALB2 (By similarity). Component of the homologous recombination repair (HR) complex composed of ERCC5/XPG, BRCA2, PALB2, DSS1 and RAD51 (By similarity). Within the complex, interacts with ERCC5/XPG and PALB2 (By similarity). Interacts directly with PALB2 which may serve as a scaffold for a HR complex containing PALB2, BRCA2, RAD51C, RAD51 and XRCC3 (By similarity). Interacts with BRCA1 only in the presence of PALB2 which serves as the bridging protein (By similarity). Interacts with POLH; the interaction is direct (By similarity). Interacts with the TREX-2 complex subunits PCID2 and SEM1 (By similarity). Interacts with HSF2BP and BRME1; the interaction with HSF2BP is direct and allows the formation of a ternary complex (PubMed:31242413, PubMed:32460033, PubMed:32845237). The complex BRME1:HSF2BP:BRCA2 interacts with SPATA22, MEIOB and RAD51 (PubMed:30760716, PubMed:32345962)
Colocalizes with ERCC5/XPG to nuclear foci following DNA replication stress

location.value: Cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, microtubule organizing center, centrosome

texts.value: Widely expressed (PubMed:9063750). Highest expression in cerebellum, testis, ileum, appendix, epididymis, ovary and mammary gland (PubMed:32460033, PubMed:9063750). No expression in lung (PubMed:9063750)
In the mammary gland, expression increases dramatically during pregnancy
Interacts with DMC1 and RAD51 through its eight BRCA2 repeats and its C-terminal TR2 region

Phosphorylated by ATM upon irradiation-induced DNA damage. Phosphorylation by CHEK1 and CHEK2 regulates interaction with RAD51. Phosphorylation at Ser-3291 by CDK1 and CDK2 is low in S phase when recombination is active, but increases as cells progress towards mitosis; this phosphorylation prevents homologous recombination-dependent repair during S phase and G2 by inhibiting RAD51 binding
Ubiquitinated in the absence of DNA damage; this does not lead to proteasomal degradation. In contrast, ubiquitination in response to DNA damage leads to proteasomal degradation

Embryonic lethality; embryos are normal throughout early pre- and post-implantation development, but development arrests after day 6.5 of gestation (PubMed:9126738). Hypersensitivity to gamma-radiations (PubMed:9126738)
